skill.name: activecampaign-automation
skill.description: Guide ActiveCampaign contact, tag, list, automation, and task workflows through Rube MCP and Composio tools.
skill.summary: Run ActiveCampaign CRM and marketing automation workflows through Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by markdown code spans around Rube MCP tool names, ActiveCampaign fields, and workflow examples. Review found no executable scripts, shell commands, prompt injection, secret access, or hidden data exfiltration. The only external URL is a disclosed Rube MCP setup endpoint for the intended integration.

content.value_statement: Manual ActiveCampaign updates slow teams and create inconsistent contact records. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows for contacts, tags, lists, automations, and tasks.
actual_capabilities: Guides Rube MCP setup and ActiveCampaign connection checks.
Finds existing contacts and creates contacts when needed.
Adds and removes tags from contacts by email or contact ID.
Subscribes or unsubscribes contacts from ActiveCampaign lists.
Enrolls existing contacts in ActiveCampaign automations.
Creates contact tasks with due dates, task types, and assignees.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active ActiveCampaign connection.
Does not create automations or discover list IDs through a dedicated tool.
Tool schemas can change, so the assistant must search tools first.
Mutating actions can change customer records and should be reviewed before execution.

use_cases.title: Prepare Campaign Contacts
use_cases.description: Create contacts, apply campaign tags, and subscribe them to the correct list.

use_cases.title: Follow Up With Leads
use_cases.description: Find qualified contacts, enroll them in an automation, and create follow-up tasks.

use_cases.title: Maintain Customer Segments
use_cases.description: Update tags and list subscriptions when lifecycle status or preferences change.

prompt_templates.title: Find or Create a Contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ActiveCampaign skill to check whether [email] exists. If absent, create the contact with [first name], [last name], and [tags]. Ask before writing changes.

prompt_templates.title: Update Contact Tags
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the contact for [email], then add [tags] and remove [tags]. Confirm the exact changes before calling any mutating tool.

prompt_templates.title: Manage List Membership
prompt_templates.prompt: Subscribe [email] to list ID [list ID] or unsubscribe them from that list. Verify the contact and summarize the result.

prompt_templates.title: Run Lifecycle Automation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow combining several ActiveCampaign actions.
prompt_templates.prompt: For each contact in this reviewed list, verify the contact, apply lifecycle tags, enroll them in automation ID [automation ID], and create a follow-up task for [date]. Report skipped contacts and reasons.

output_examples.input: Find jane@example.com and create her if missing with the webinar lead tag.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks the current tool schema, searches for the email address, asks before creating a missing contact, and reports the final contact status.

output_examples.input: Add the customer tag and remove the trial tag for a known contact.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms the target contact, lists the planned tag changes, runs the tag update after approval, and summarizes what changed.

output_examples.input: Create a follow-up task for a contact after an automation enrollment.
output_examples.output: The assistant verifies the contact and automation ID, checks the due date format, creates the task, and returns the task title and due date.

best_practices: Search current Rube tool schemas before each workflow.
Confirm contact identity before changing tags, lists, automations, or tasks.
Batch bulk changes with delays and keep a review log.
anti_patterns: Do not use placeholder dates or unknown IDs for tasks and automations.
Do not assume list names are the same as numeric list IDs.
Do not run bulk unsubscribe or automation enrollment without user confirmation.

faq.question: Does this skill require an ActiveCampaign API key?
faq.answer: It uses Rube MCP and Composio connection management instead of storing an API key in the skill.

faq.question: Can it create new ActiveCampaign automations?
faq.answer: No. It can enroll contacts in existing active automations.

faq.question: Can it handle bulk contact updates?
faq.answer: Yes, but bulk updates should use delays, confirmations, and review logs to respect rate limits.

faq.question: What does the assistant check before using tools?
faq.answer: It should call RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS first to get current schemas and parameter requirements.

faq.question: Does the skill store contact data?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a markdown guide. Contact data flows through connected Rube and ActiveCampaign tools.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
